clue.c1.d: Six girls. October 24, 9 PM. Lucía is the first one.
clue.c2.d: Wet, muddy. It was lying in the hallway.
clue.c3.d: “REHEARSAL 9 PM — DON'T MISS IT!”. I shot it through the glass.
clue.c4.d: Laughter. A rehearsal. Then a cut.
clue.c5.d: I recorded the room's silence. It wasn't empty.
clue.c6.d: On the back, in her handwriting: “don't trust my phone”.

people.lucia: My little sister. 16. She loved theater.
people.daniela: Her ID was lying in the hallway, wet. Her bare footprints are still there.
people.renata: She asked what the seventh chair was for. Now she only exists in mirrors.
people.anapaula: She mimicked everyone; it was her joke. Now she mimics me: if I run, she runs.
people.unknown: I don't know anything about her yet.

door.midEarly: Swollen with damp. It won't move… yet.
th.start: The gate of San Aurelio. Nobody has opened it in a year… and tonight it's open.
th.gate: It closed by itself. Nobody pushed it.
th.hall: It smells of damp and old wax. The lights are still on. For whom?
th.corridor: The lockers. Lucía's was around here… I can't remember the number.
th.classroom: Chairs in a circle. As if the rehearsal never ended.
th.bathroom: Four mirrors. I don't look quite right in any of them.
th.long: This hallway has no end. And not one light that holds.
ex.poster: Six faces. The first one is Lucía's. I taped it up myself, months ago.
ex.bench: I used to wait for her here. She always came out last, script in hand.
ex.trophies: Drama trophies. The newest says “Best cast 2023”. Six names engraved. One surname has been scratched off.
ex.clock: Stopped at 9:00 PM. It's not the battery: the second hand trembles, but won't move on.
ex.locker12: Locked. A paper heart is stuck on it: “D + R”.
ex.locker21: Locked. A smell of stagnant water comes through the slots.
ex.drawings: Grade-school drawings. One shows seven figures holding hands. The seventh has no face.
ex.fountain: No water. Just a dark, warm trickle.
ex.extinguisher: Expired in 2019. Nobody checks anything in this school.
ex.drag: Drag marks. They lead to the bathroom. They were made by fingers.
ex.bin: Wet flyers: “THE LAST PERFORMANCE — one night only — free entry”. No date on them.
ex.chair: The only overturned chair. Someone stood up in a hurry.
ex.board: “REHEARSAL 9 PM — DON'T MISS IT!”. Same hour as the poster. The chalk still stains: nobody erased it in a year.
ex.window: Only rain outside. The yard looks farther away than it should.
ex.sink: Dried blood around the drain. And something small and hard… fingernails.
ex.mirror: My reflection copies me a moment late. Must be exhaustion.
ex.bucket: A bucket of black water. The mop is still damp.
ex.stallOpen: A backpack on the toilet lid. “F. Vidal” is stitched on it. Inside, a pair of glasses with a cracked lens.
ex.stallA: Scratched into the door, from the inside, with something sharp: “IT WAS NOT A REHEARSAL”.
ex.stallB: Nothing. Just the toilet water, black and still… until it moves.
ex.puddle: Ankle-deep water. Something crossed it not long ago: it's still trembling.
ex.longWindow: Rain beats the glass. On the other side there are handprints… on the inside.
ex.credential: A school ID, wet and muddy: Daniela Soto. S02 on the poster.
ex.recorder: The drama club's recorder. A cassette is loaded: “10/24”. The night of the rehearsal.
ex.photo: A photo of Lucía in the yard, smiling. On the back, in her handwriting: “don't trust my phone”.
ex.key: A key with tape on it: “STAIRS 1”. Lucía hid it here. The gate has more padlocks.
doc.notice.title: NOTICE FROM THE PRINCIPAL
doc.notice.body:
October 28, 2024

By order of the Principal's office, Wing B will remain closed until further notice. The drama club is suspended.

The school states that it did NOT authorize any night rehearsal on the 24th, and has no record of any teacher in charge of the club this year.

Families are asked not to spread rumors.
doc.notice.note:
Someone wrote over it in red pen:
“then who let them in?”
doc.diary.title: Isabel O.'s notebook
doc.diary.body:
10/23
Dani says the new teacher isn't on any list. Nobody at the office knows him.

There's rehearsal tomorrow anyway. At night. He says the play only works at night.

Lucía doesn't want to go. Neither do I. But there are six of us and he said all six have to be there.

Renata asked what the seventh chair is for. He laughed.
doc.script.title: THE LAST PERFORMANCE — final act
doc.script.body:
(Six chairs in a circle. A seventh, empty.)
(The light goes out.)

CHORUS:
When the light goes out, nobody moves.
She who moves, stays.
She who looks back, stays.
She who answers, stays.

(Silence. The seventh enters.)
doc.script.note: In the margin, in different handwriting: “the teacher didn't write this. nobody knows who did”

intro.1.head: SAN AURELIO SCHOOL · OCTOBER 24, 2024 · 9 PM
intro.1.body: Six students from the drama club stayed for a night rehearsal. They were preparing a play nobody had ever seen: “The Last Performance”.
intro.2.body: None of them came home. No forced doors, no witnesses, not a single camera. The school said it never authorized that rehearsal. They closed Wing B and, as the months went by, the case too.
intro.3.body: One of the six was Lucía Ríos. Sixteen years old. Your little sister.
intro.4.body: You are the one next to her in the photo. You have been looking for her for a year: you taped up the posters, kept her number, kept texting it even when nobody answered.

stuck.lockerItems: Lucía left something inside the locker.
stuck.bath: The second floor: the lab and the bathroom. The drag marks lead to the bathroom.
stuck.mirror: “Look at the mirrors.” I see nothing with my own eyes. What about the camera?
stuck.code: Three numbers. I saw them written on the mirror.
people.lucia.diary: She didn't want to go to the rehearsal that night. She went anyway.
people.lucia.photo: She hid one of the stairwell keys in her locker and left me a warning: don't trust her phone.
people.daniela.heart: “D + R” on locker 12. She and Renata were inseparable.
people.renata.heart: “D + R” on locker 12. She and Daniela were inseparable.
people.anapaula.trophy: “Best cast 2023”. Her surname was scratched off the trophy.
people.fernanda: Her backpack was left in a bathroom stall. Inside, her broken glasses.
people.isabel: Her notebook was in a backpack in the hallway. She wrote that the new teacher wasn't on any list.
intro.5.body: Tonight it has been one year. At 8:58 PM, her number answered.
intro.6.body: It is 9 PM. The same hour. You are standing at the gate of San Aurelio, phone in hand and nobody to tell.

ex.mirrorCam: Nothing to the naked eye. Lucía said to look at the mirrors… with the camera.
th.recording: The tape keeps turning. It's recording the silence of the room.
th.recordingElsewhere: It's recording. All you can hear in here is rain.
th.staff: The staff room. It smells of cold coffee. Nobody came back for their things.
th.lab: The lab. The jars are watching me from the shelf.
th.janitor: The janitor's service room. He kept the keys to the whole school in here.
ex.seized: A box: “CONFISCATED ITEMS”. On top, a hand mirror with a tag: “R. Cruz — 3rd time”.
ex.sofa: A sagging couch. Someone slept here. There are nail marks on the armrest.
ex.cabinet: The filing cabinet. The “Drama club 2024” folder is empty. Only the label is left.
ex.jars: Jars of formaldehyde. One holds a long lock of black hair, tied with a uniform ribbon.
ex.fallenJar: A jar on the floor, unbroken. The lid is on the inside.
ex.labSink: The tap drips. The water runs warm, as if someone had used it a moment ago.
ex.labWindow: Rain over the yard. You can see the gym from here. One light is on.
ex.radio: The janitor's radio. Just static… and, far underneath, applause.
ex.keys: The key board. Two are missing: “STAIRS” and “GYM”.
ex.shelves: Bleach, rags, spare fluorescent tubes. And a “lost and found” box: six uniform ties, knotted together.
people.renata.mirror: A hand mirror was confiscated from her three times. She was never without it.
people.anapaula.lab: She wrote in her notebook that the teacher repeated everything she said, half a second later.

doc.minutes.title: MINUTES — meeting of 10/25/2024
doc.minutes.body:
1. Six students did not return home after an unauthorized activity.

2. No teacher admits to having run the drama club. Room 2B has been listed as “unused” since March.

3. The janitor states he saw a man open the gym for them. He cannot describe him.

4. It is resolved to close Wing B and make no statements.
doc.minutes.note: Item 3 has been crossed out so hard the page tore.
doc.labbook.title: Ana Paula M.'s notebook
doc.labbook.body:
I tested him today. I said a made-up word, one that doesn't exist.

He said it back exactly. In my voice.

I mimic people because it comes naturally. He doesn't mimic: he copies. Half a second late, like an echo.

I told Lucía. She says she gets messages from her own number.
doc.labbook.note: “If you run, she runs. If you stay still, she waits.”
doc.log.title: Janitor's log — 10/24
doc.log.body:
8:40 PM — Six students arrive. They say they have rehearsal. I have no notice of anything.
8:55 PM — A teacher asks me for the gym key. I don't know him, but he knows my name.
9:00 PM — Power goes out in Wing B.
9:10 PM — Applause in the gym. I go to look. The chairs are in a circle. Nobody is there.
9:30 PM — The key was returned. It was on my desk. The office door was locked from the inside.
doc.log.note: The last line, in different handwriting: “seven chairs. one is missing.”
